title: A researcher of extraterrestrial phenomena, on the UFOs detected by the US: "Far beyond our technological capabilities"
excerpt: The professional in the field tried to resolve an age-old question that the average citizen asks about this mystery
content:
It is one of the questions that at some point we have all asked ourselves: is there life beyond us in the universe? Well, over time, the administration of the United States has been declassifying some 500 secret files on unidentified aerial objects.

Recently, another 40 documents and three videos recorded in the Middle East have been released. Trump, the American leader, noted in a statement from the Oval Office that U.S. aviation professionals have told him that there are “very strange” things out there: “There is something out there, because they are flying an F22, a fighter jet, the fastest aircraft, and something goes past them at three times their speed. And it is something round, it is not aerodynamic, it is round.”

To analyze all these classifications made by the president of the United States, ‘La Tarde’, a program on Cadena Cope hosted by Pilar García Muñiz, invited Josep Guijarro, researcher and director of the ‘Espacio Misterio’ portal.

Josep Guijarro: “The Trump administration could use this as a smokescreen”

Guijarro highlighted that in 2023 the US radar recorded eight detections in just 84 seconds: “They were at an altitude between 55,000 and 70,000 feet. This is equivalent to 21 km in altitude. Commercial airplanes do not fly at that height. It would be moving at 2,700 km/h, which would mean that it is far beyond the technological capabilities that any government on Earth has at the moment”.

On the other hand, the researcher pointed out that this wave of discrediting by the Trump administration may be a kind of media “smokescreen” used for specific moments. However, despite what is coming to light about these circular or triangular objects and the fact that they are capable of rising silently, without engines and vertically, it all remains a genuine mystery.
